nameOrigin: hard substance used for crockery and decorations

pokedexEntries.ru: CLAYDOL are said to be dolls of mud made by primitive humans and brought to life by exposure to a mysterious ray. This POKéMON moves about while levitating.

pokedexEntries.sa: CLAYDOL is an enigma that appeared from a clay statue made by an ancient civilization dating back 20,000 years. This POKéMON shoots beams from both its hands.

pokedexEntries.frlg: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

pokedexEntries.em: A CLAYDOL sleeps while hovering in midair. Its arms are separate from its body. They are kept floating by the POKéMON’s manipulation of psychic power.

pokedexEntries.dpp: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.

pokedexEntries.hgss: It is said that it originates from clay dolls made by an ancient civilization.

pokedexEntries.bw: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

pokedexEntries.y: It is said that it originates from clay dolls made by an ancient civilization.

pokedexEntries.as: Claydol is an enigma that appeared from a clay statue made by an ancient civilization dating back 20,000 years. This Pokémon shoots beams from both its hands.

pokedexEntries.us: If it gets wet, its body melts. When rain starts to fall, it wraps its whole body up with its psychic powers to protect itself.

pokedexEntries.um: The ancient people who made it apparently modeled it after something that descended from the sky. It fires beams from both arms.
